Tớ thế bao giờ? Tớ thật sự không phải người như thế.
(송지원) 돈이 차고 넘치니
Do you have so much money? It wasn't too long ago you were borrowing.
When did I borrow? That's not who I am!

rows.vi:
Khi em nói em là sinh viên,
tôi còn tưởng em ra vẻ nữa.
Nghĩ lại cũng đều do tôi tự ti
vì chỉ tốt nghiệp cấp ba.
Tôi vẫn chưa hoàn thiện bản thân.
rows.en:
When you said you were a college student...
I thought you were conceited.
When I think about it, I was not confident about myself
not going to college.
I still need to grow.

rows.en:
Something happened?
My brother didn't die.
For six years...
I thought he actually died this time.
I've been hoping for that.

rows.vi:
Nếu giờ tôi yếu đuối…
thì sẽ chấm hết.
Vậy nên…
đừng thích tôi nữa.
rows.en:
If I become weak now,
it will be the end.
So...
don't like me.

tôi sẽ trở nên yếu đuối.

rows.en:
Do you still like me?
Yes.
You shouldn't.
When I think someone likes me...
it makes me weak.
